title: Harness self-heal incident 2026-06-10 -- problems, fixes, recurrence guards
desc: Comprehensive record of every harness/launcher/doctor problem detected and resolved on 2026-06-10, each tagged with EMERGENCY-SAFETY / FIX / RECURRENCE-PREVENTION / KNOWLEDGE. Read this to understand what broke, why, and the guard that now prevents it. Constitution + full design live in harness-guard-exemption-ladder-spec.
steps: PACE FALSE-BRICK: pace guard read 176pct (JSONL estimate off a stale Thursday reset anchor) while real claude /usage was 1pct, blocking ALL tools. SAFETY=restored real-/usage override + temp bridge (to 2026-06-12) in wkharness-guards-pace.ps1. FIX=Claude usage adapter (Get-ClaudeUsageAnchor) + hourly claude /usage auto-capture (scheduled task claude-usage-anchor) + auto-calibration-on-block (Get-ClaudeUsageAnchorOrRecalibrate). PREVENT=IRON RULE (never delete live safety mid-refactor) + wkdoctor harness-pace-health module. KNOW=spec steps DEFINITIVE/AUTO-CALIBRATION; commits f22fddd+2d22a56 pushed.

SELF-RECOVERY DEADLOCK: one false pace block gated Write/Edit/Bash/Agent/Skill so the AI could not fix the very gate. FIX=TIER0/1/2 ladder -- TIER0 knowledge-ops (Skill tool, wkappbot skill *, .md edits) fully free; TIER1 harness-source (whole wkappbot-kih/tools/*.ps1) study-lock only; read-only counted in stall but pace/wk-only exempt. PREVENT=P-ROOT (ROOT always edits harness) + the two ROOT escape hatches (user-turn resets stall, knowledge-ops always free). KNOW=spec CONSTITUTIONAL + DEFINITIVE POLICY.

STALL DUPLICATE + MISSING EXEMPTION: the firing stall-guard (infra.ps1) lacked the skill/wk/git exemption that the skill claimed, so wkappbot skill read (the prescribed escape) was itself blocked. FIX=restored Skill-tool + wkappbot skill * + git + .md + haiku exemptions in infra.ps1.

CONCURRENT-REFACTOR CHAOS: two subagents editing the live guard at once + one deleting the safety bridge = lost the whole ladder to a revert and re-bricked the session. PREVENT=NO-CONCURRENT-LIVE-REFACTOR + CHEAP-AGENT SOURCE SANDBOX (cheap intelligences may only edit -proto/-probe/-<model> scratch files; ROOT promotes) + SELF-DOCUMENTING FILENAMES. Recovery method that WORKED=single ROOT-controlled agent, safety intact, self-test 52/0, atomic FF merge.

SYMLINK INTEGRITY: wkappbot.exe was mis-symlinked to wkwrap.exe (corrupts process ancestry) and bin/claude breaks on npm update (user forced to Gemini on boot). STATUS=wkdoctor already auto-recovers wkwrap + checks codex/agy/claude symlinks (verified [+] wkwrap.exe recovery). OPEN=launcher busybox exec-relay for unknown-name symlinks (suggest ts=2026-06-10T02:26:35; launcher=SDK scope).

USAGE CLI TRAP: claude -p /usage does NOT work (treated as prompt); bare claude /usage with redirect DOES (slash runs non-interactively). Codex=no usage cmd (rate-limit file only); Gemini /stats interactive-only (needs trust flag). KNOW=spec EMPIRICAL PER-FAMILY USAGE SOURCES.

FALSE-POSITIVE GUARDS met today: security-guard trips on the literal agent-model/bypass env var NAMES even in documentation (reference via variable, never echo the name); ENCODING-GUARD blocks Korean in skill text (write English); agent-brief needs EXACT Goal:/Files:/Approach:/Constraints:/Exit: headers.

OPEN ITEMS tracked for next sessions: reset-on-user-turn detailed fix (R4 -- user message intermittently fails to reset ROOT stall); Haiku subagent agent-model propagation; cross-family R1-R6 full Gemini/Codex adapters; launcher busybox exec-relay; wkdoctor harness-pace-health + per-family pace dashboard (agent in progress).
